lines.zh: 昨日妈妈问我地想唔想食沙律？
lines.jp: zok6 jat6 maa4 maa1 man6 ngo5 dei6 soeng2 m4 soeng2 sik6 saa1 leot6
lines.en: Yesterday Mum asked us whether we wanted to eat salad

lines.jp: ngo5 dei6 go3 go3 dou1 waa6 hou2 soeng2 sik6
lines.en: Every one of us said we really wanted to

lines.zh: 妈妈话，“好好，我就整龙虾沙律俾你地食喇。
lines.jp: maa4 maa1 waa6, “hou2 hou2, ngo5 zau6 zing2 lung4 haa1 saa1 leot6 bei2 nei5 dei6 sik6 laa1
lines.en: Mum said, “Fine, then I'll make lobster salad for you to eat

lines.zh: 呐，宜家我去买龙虾，你地去买啲新鲜生果返黎喇。”
lines.jp: naa4, ji4 gaa1 ngo5 heoi3 maai5 lung4 haa1, nei5 dei6 heoi3 maai5 di1 san1 sin1 saang1 gwo2 faan1 lai4 laa1”
lines.en: Now, I'll go and buy the lobster; you go and buy some fresh fruit and bring it back”

lines.zh: 我地买咗好多新鲜生果返屋企，又一齐喺厨房预备嗰啲生果。
lines.jp: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 sin1 saang1 gwo2 faan1 nguk1 kei5, jau6 jat1 cai4 hai2 cyu4 fong2 jyu6 bei6 go2 di1 saang1 gwo2
lines.en: We bought lots of fresh fruit and brought it home, and together prepared that fruit in the kitchen

lines.zh: 半个钟头之后妈妈返黎勒。
lines.jp: bun3 go3 zung1 tau4 zi1 hau6 maa4 maa1 faan1 lai4 laak3
lines.en: Half an hour later Mum came back

lines.zh: 佢话，“今日啲龙虾又细又唔新鲜，所以我冇买，只係买咗啲大虾啫。
lines.jp: keoi5 waa6, “gam1 jat6 di1 lung4 haa1 jau6 sai3 jau6 m4 san1 sin1, so2 ji5 ngo5 mou5 maai5, zi2 hai6 maai5 zo2 di1 daai6 haa1 ze1
lines.en: She said, “Today the lobsters were both small and not fresh, so I didn't buy any; I only bought some prawns

lines.zh: 你地就食大虾沙律当龙虾沙律喇。”
lines.jp: nei5 dei6 zau6 sik6 daai6 haa1 saa1 leot6 dong3 lung4 haa1 saa1 leot6 laa1”
lines.en: So you'll just eat prawn salad in place of lobster salad”

dialogues.title: Passage 2
dialogues.setting: Read out loud the following passage and translate it into English

lines.jp: gam1 jat6 ngo5 faan1 se2 zi6 lau4
lines.en: Today I went to the office

lines.zh: 何先生话我听礼拜六佢要搭飞机返去英国，所以喺礼拜三之后就唔返写字楼勒。
lines.jp: Ho4 sin1 saang1 waa6 ngo5 teng1 lai5 baai3 luk6 keoi5 jiu3 daap3 fei1 gei1 faan1 heoi3 jing1 gwok3, so2 ji5 hai2 lai5 baai3 saam1 zi1 hau6 zau6 m4 faan1 se2 zi6 lau4 laak3
lines.en: Mr. Ho told me that next Saturday he has to fly back to Britain, so after Wednesday he won't be coming to the office any more

lines.zh: 何先生係我最好嘅朋友之一，佢呢次返去英国之后，我估就唔返黎嘅勒。
lines.jp: Ho4 sin1 saang1 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 pang4 jau5 zi1 jat1, keoi5 ni1 ci3 faan1 heoi3 jing1 gwok3 zi1 hau6, ngo5 gu2 zau6 m4 faan1 lai4 ge3 lak6
lines.en: Mr. Ho is one of my best friends; after he goes back to Britain this time, I guess he won't be coming back

lines.zh: 咁，我要送乜嘢俾佢好呢？
lines.jp: gam2, ngo5 jiu3 sung3 mat1 je5 bei2 keoi5 hou2 ne1
lines.en: So, what would be a good present for me to give him?

lines.zh: 我想咗好耐都冇主意，就去问王小姐同张太太，
lines.jp: ngo5 soeng2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 mou5 zyu2 ji3, zau6 heoi3 man6 Wong4 siu2 ze2 tung4 Zoeng1 taai3 taai3
lines.en: I thought about it for a long time and still had no idea, so I went to ask Miss Wong and Mrs. Cheung

lines.zh: 王小姐话，“我地三个人一齐请何先生食饭喇！好吗？”
lines.jp: Wong4 siu2 ze2 waa6, “ngo5 dei6 saam1 go3 jan4 jat1 cai4 cing2 Ho4 sin1 saang1 sik6 faan6 laa1! hou2 maa1?”
lines.en: Miss Wong said, “Let the three of us invite Mr. Ho to a meal together! OK?”

lines.zh: 张太太话，“如果何太太可以同何先生一齐黎，咁就最好勒。”
lines.jp: Zoeng1 taai3 taai3 waa6, “jyu4 gwo2 Ho4 taai3 taai3 ho2 ji5 tung4 Ho4 sin1 saang1 jat1 cai4 lai4, gam2 zau6 zeoi3 hou2 laak3”
lines.en: Mrs. Cheung said, “If Mrs. Ho can come along with Mr. Ho, that would be best of all”

lines.zh: 我话小姐同太太嘅主意一定係最好嘅。
lines.jp: ngo5 waa6 siu2 ze2 tung4 taai3 taai3 ge3 zyu2 ji3 jat1 ding6 hai6 zeoi3 hou2 ge3
lines.en: I said that Miss Wong's and Mrs. Cheung's idea was definitely the best

lines.jp: nei5 waa6 hai6 m4 hai6 aa3
lines.en: What do you say, is it or isn't it?

exercises.title: Passage 2 translation
exercises.instructions: Read out loud the following passage and translate it into English (Passage 2, see dialogue u7-d2)

items.prompt: 今日我返写字楼。何先生话我听礼拜六佢要搭飞机返去英国，所以喺礼拜三之后就唔返写字楼勒。何先生係我最好嘅朋友之一，佢呢次返去英国之后，我估就唔返黎嘅勒。咁，我要送乜嘢俾佢好呢？我想咗好耐都冇主意，就去问王小姐同张太太，王小姐话，“我地三个人一齐请何先生食饭喇！好吗？”张太太话，“如果何太太可以同何先生一齐黎，咁就最好勒。”我话小姐同太太嘅主意一定係最好嘅。你话係唔係呀？
items.answer: Today I went to the office. Mr. Ho told me that next Saturday he has to fly back to Britain, so after Wednesday he won't be coming to the office any more. Mr. Ho is one of my best friends; after he goes back to Britain this time, I guess he won't be coming back. So, what would be a good present for me to give him? I thought about it for a long time and still had no idea, so I went to ask Miss Wong and Mrs. Cheung. Miss Wong said, “Let the three of us invite Mr. Ho to a meal together! OK?” Mrs. Cheung said, “If Mrs. Ho can come along with Mr. Ho, that would be best of all.” I said that Miss Wong's and Mrs. Cheung's idea was definitely the best. What do you say, is it or isn't it?
items.hint: Line-by-line Jyutping is in dialogue u7-d2

notes.title: About this unit
notes.body: Unit 7 is a review of Units 1-6 (Dr. Candise Lin). It introduces no new vocabulary or grammar: it consists of two reading passages (Passage 1 about buying lobster for a salad; Passage 2 about a farewell meal for Mr. Ho) and six exercises: true/false and comprehension questions on Passage 1, translation into Cantonese, two one-sided phone conversations (4a, 4b), fill-in-the-blanks, and inserting plugs (世界, 三个人, 之一, 一定, 一齐) into sentences. Vocabulary worth revising from the passages: 沙律 saa1 leot6 (salad), 龙虾 lung4 haa1 (lobster), 大虾 daai6 haa1 (prawn), 新鲜 san1 sin1 (fresh), 生果 saang1 gwo2 (fruit), 厨房 cyu4 fong2 (kitchen), 预备 jyu6 bei6 (prepare), 当 dong3 (treat as / in place of), 主意 zyu2 ji3 (idea), 送 sung3 (give as a present), 估 gu2 (guess), 如果 jyu4 gwo2 (if).
